title: 第151章 对决
slug: 电竞世界冠军选秀c位出道
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

江执屿一页一页慢慢翻看着，手上的动作很慢，视线仔仔细细从每一个字上扫过。

他脸上全程没有什么大的情绪波动，只是眼眶微微泛红，和眼尾舞台妆的淡红眼影相融。

指腹反复摩挲纸面凹凸的纹路，停留最久的是最后一页一句涂改两次的话：你可以不逆野，你只需要快乐。

他始终沉默着，没有说话。

良久，江执屿抬手，从湖水蓝花束侧边抽出一枝花。

随即他低头将花茎插进黑色工装舞台服左侧胸口口袋，用扣子和布料间隙固定住花茎，平整别在左胸口处。

蓝花冷色和纯黑面料视觉颜色相撞，带着浑然天成的贵气。

江执屿捧着鲜亮的湖水蓝色花束，拿着笔记本，一步一步走回了后台候场区。

后台，姚为正坐在椅子上目不转睛盯着转播屏，眼中放着光。

余光瞥见消失已久的江执屿终于回归，忙不迭扭头问：“怎么去了这么久？有什么事吗？”

江执屿小心把花束和笔记本放在一侧的长椅上，随口应答：“没事，隐藏摄像机，流程比较长，耽误了时间。”

姚为了然点头，没有继续这个话题，而是兴致勃勃开口：“林森和米蓝这两组投票完，就到我们和安俊英组的了！”

“嗯。”江执屿重新落座，视线也投向后台的转播屏。

场上还在介绍接下来上场的人员名单，江执屿看着闪烁的灯光，突然开口问：“刚刚第一组，哪队赢了？”

姚为很快接话，语气轻快：“隗双啊！”

江执屿挑了挑眉，没有很惊讶，隗双的进步速度和人气涨幅都飞快。

身旁的姚为还在继续说：“而且票差还挺大的，隗双那个舞台确实挺炸，舞台效果很好。”

这时，前场的第二组对决陆续上台。

林森带队的《失重象限》，曲风是电子流行乐。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Jiang Zhiyu slowly flipped through the pages, his hands moving very slowly, and his eyes scanning every word carefully.

There were no major emotional fluctuations on his face during the whole process, but his eyes were slightly red, which blended with the light red eyeshadow of the stage makeup at the end of his eyes.

My fingertips repeatedly rubbed the uneven texture on the paper, and what stayed on it the longest was a sentence that was redacted twice on the last page: You don’t have to go against the grain, you just need to be happy.

He remained silent and did not speak.

After a long time, Jiang Zhiyu raised his hand and pulled out a flower from the side of the lake blue bouquet.

Then he lowered his head and inserted the flower stem into the left breast pocket of his black overalls and stage clothes, fixed the flower stem with buttons and gaps in the fabric, and pinned it flatly to his left chest.

The cool color of blue flowers and pure black fabrics visually collide, giving it a natural nobility.

Jiang Zhiyu held a bright lake blue bouquet and a notebook, and walked back to the backstage waiting area step by step.

Backstage, Yao Weizheng was sitting on a chair staring at the broadcast screen, his eyes shining.

Out of the corner of his eye, he saw Jiang Zhiyu finally returning after disappearing for a long time. He turned around and asked, "Why have you been gone for so long? What's the matter?"

Jiang Zhiyu carefully placed the bouquet and notebook on a bench on one side and responded casually: "It's okay, the camera is hidden. The process is quite long and it wastes time."

Yao Weoran nodded and did not continue the topic, but spoke enthusiastically: "After the two groups Lin Sen and Mi Lan voted, it's time for our group with An Junying!"

"Yes." Jiang Zhiyu sat down again and looked at the broadcast screen in the background.

The list of next players was still being introduced on the field. Jiang Zhiyu looked at the flashing lights and suddenly asked: "Which team won the first group just now?"

Yao Wei answered quickly and said in a brisk tone: "Kui Shuang!"

Jiang Zhiyu raised his eyebrows, not very surprised. Wei Shuang's progress and popularity were increasing rapidly.

Yao Wei beside him continued: "And the ticket difference is quite big. The stage in Weishuang is really popular and the stage effect is very good."

At this time, the second group of duels in the frontcourt came on stage.

"Weightless Quadrant", led by Lin Sen, has an electronic pop music style.
